theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Industrials (+1.13%) and Technology (+0.87%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.26%) and Financials (-0.62%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.47%, defensives +0.32%, and value/cyclicals -0.22% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.45%, Dow +0.07%, Nasdaq +0.80% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.51%. The VIX fell 2.96% to 16.70, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 0.61% to $4,393.80, crude oil was little changed at $101.78, and bitcoin gained 0.20% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
